Tell users before sending prompts, options, or referenced URLs to RunComfy. Keep web grounding off unless requested.
Prefer a pinned or local CLI installation when possible. Do not run npx or global npm setup automatically.
Continue documenting token file location, owner-only permissions, and the RUNCOMFY_TOKEN alternative for CI environments.

content.user_title: Generate Nano Banana 2 Images on RunComfy
content.value_statement: Image teams need fast visual drafts without rebuilding model calls by hand. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Nano Banana 2 generation on RunComfy.
actual_capabilities: Routes text-to-image requests to the RunComfy Nano Banana 2 endpoint.
Documents supported image counts, seeds, aspect ratios, resolutions, formats, and safety tolerance.
Provides invocation patterns for default drafts, four-image batches, seed-locked finals, and web-grounded prompts.
Explains prompt patterns for subject-first descriptions, quoted in-image text, and stable refinements.
Lists RunComfy CLI prerequisites, exit codes, token storage behavior, and outbound endpoints.
limitations: It supports still image generation only, not video or direct image editing.
It requires the RunComfy CLI, a RunComfy account, and network access.
Prompts and referenced URLs may be sent to RunComfy model servers.
Each request supports up to four images, and higher resolutions may cost more.

use_cases.title: Create Marketing Drafts
use_cases.description: Generate quick product or campaign visuals before committing design time to final artwork.

use_cases.title: Produce Social Variants
use_cases.description: Build vertical or wide image batches for social platforms with controlled aspect ratios and text placement.

use_cases.title: Refine Prompt Experiments
use_cases.description: Use seeds and resolution tiers to compare prompt changes while keeping a stable composition.

prompt_templates.title: Simple Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Nano Banana 2 to generate one 1K square image of [subject] in [style]. Save the result to [folder].

prompt_templates.title: Four Concept Batch
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate four 0.5K vertical Nano Banana 2 concepts for [campaign]. Include the exact text [words] and keep the layout clean.

prompt_templates.title: Seeded Final Pass
prompt_templates.prompt: Regenerate the selected Nano Banana 2 concept at 2K with seed [number]. Keep the composition stable and adjust [specific change].

prompt_templates.title: Web-Grounded Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a web-grounded Nano Banana 2 image for [current event or real entity]. Use current context only when needed.

output_examples.input: A user asks for a square product hero image for a new ceramic mug.
output_examples.output: The assistant generates one image and reports the prompt focus, resolution, aspect ratio, and saved output location.

output_examples.input: A content producer asks for four vertical social concepts with exact headline text.
output: Four draft images are produced for comparison.
The assistant notes the vertical format, quoted text, and lower draft resolution.

output_examples.input: A workflow builder asks to refine one concept using the same seed at higher resolution.
output_examples.output: The assistant keeps the composition stable, raises the resolution, and summarizes the changed prompt details.

best_practices: Use subject-first prompts with one or two clear style anchors.
Quote exact in-image text and describe its placement.
Keep web search off unless the prompt needs current real-world context.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for image edits that need subject preservation.
Do not request unsupported aspect ratios or custom resolution values.
Do not run generated commands without confirming network use and output paths.

faq.question: What does this skill generate?
faq.answer: It generates still images through the RunComfy Nano Banana 2 text-to-image endpoint.

faq.question: Does it require a RunComfy account?
faq.answer: Yes. The RunComfy CLI must be installed and authenticated before generation can run.

faq.question: Can it edit existing images?
faq.answer: No. The skill points users to a separate Nano Banana Edit skill for image editing workflows.

faq.question: When should web search be enabled?
faq.answer: Enable it only for prompts about current events or real entities that need current context.

faq.question: How many images can one request produce?
faq.answer: The documented endpoint supports one to four images per request.

faq.question: What security notice should users see?
faq.answer: Users should know that prompts go to RunComfy and that local CLI commands need confirmation.
